full_judgment:
This rule is directed against the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Barisal in Title Appeal No. 59 of 1985 affirming those of the learned Munsif, 1st Court, Barisal passed in Title Suit No. 640 of 1984. 

 6. The learned Munsif considering the evidence adduced by the parties decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff opposite party Nos. 1-11. As against that decree the petitioner preferred Title Appeal No. 59 of 1985 which was heard and disposed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Barisal. On 30.9.85, the appeal was dismissed on contest and the judgment and decree of the trial court was affirmed. It was the concurrent findings of both the courts below that the order of termination of services was malafide, without jurisdiction and made in contravention of the provision of the Service Regulations. 

 11. Considering all these aspects of the case I do not find any ground to interfere with the impugned Judgment and decree of the Courts below. Accordingly, the rule is discharged without any order as to costs.
